title: Offer Property Tax Appeal Help to Your Clients
summary: Check whether a client's home looks over-assessed and hand them a drafted appeal with an evidence summary, as a useful extra service after a sale.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you already have past clients who own homes; the value is time saved and goodwill, not new fees.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: A useful extra service that keeps past clients coming back.
Less time per appeal than drafting it by hand.
who_its_for: Real estate agents who stay in touch with past buyers.

stack.name: Property Tax Appeal
stack.role: Compares the assessment with recent nearby sales and drafts the appeal and evidence summary under county rules.
stack.creator: chrishadges1

stack.name: Post Call Assistant
stack.role: Turns each client call into to-dos and a follow-up draft.
stack.creator: itspriyaptl

steps.name: Property Tax Appeal
steps.does: Drafts the appeal and evidence summary

steps.name: Post Call Assistant
steps.does: Lists next steps and drafts a follow-up

outputs: A drafted appeal and evidence summary
A clear next step for the client

steps: Collect the client's assessment notice and address.
Run the check and read the comparable sales.
Review the draft appeal and the county deadline.
Hand it to the client to file, or refer them to a professional.
guardrails: This is not tax or legal advice; check local rules on who may file for someone else.
Verify every comparable sale before anything is filed.
